💡 De-Nox | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: Cleaning up disk space occupied by build artifacts and dependencies of inactive software projects without accidentally deleting files from active projects.
✨ Key Features: • Intelligent disk cleanup based on project activity, not just artifact age • Terminal-based TUI using ratatui • Read-only until explicit deletion confirmation • Fast scanning by avoiding deep dives into artifact directories
📖 Summary: De-Nox is a Rust-based terminal disk-cleanup tool that intelligently identifies and removes dormant build artifacts like `node_modules` and `target`. It differentiates between truly abandoned projects and active ones by analyzing the last modification date of the project's source files, not just the artifact directories themselves.
